# Alibre Shapes Add-On

- Shapes Add-On generates standard steel profiles in the part you have open, and doubles as a template for writing your own profile generators.
  - What it does
    - Adds a menu built from the generator scripts it finds on disk, so adding a script adds a menu item.
    - Ships one generator that models a square hollow section with proper inner and outer corner fillets.
    - Covers hot-formed and cold-formed dimension tables from 20 mm up to 400 mm.
    - Binds itself to the active part or assembly before each generator runs.
    - Includes installer configurations and build scripts for packaging a release.
  - What you need
    - Alibre Design with the AlibreScript add-on installed.
    - The .NET Framework 4.8.1 runtime on 64-bit Windows.
    - Visual Studio or MSBuild if you want to build it yourself.
  - Getting started
    - Build `source/alibre-shapes-addon.sln` in Release configuration.
    - Copy the build output into your Alibre Design add-ons directory.
    - Start Alibre Design, open a part, and choose a profile from the menu.
    - To add your own profile, drop a new script beside the bundled one and restart Alibre.
  - Where things live
    - `source/` holds the C# add-on, the generator scripts, and the installer configuration.
    - `documentation/` holds the installer notes.
  - Good to know
    - This build ships as a demo and a template, so it comes with one generator rather than a full catalogue.
    - Generator scripts run under IronPython 2.7, so keep them compatible with Python 2.7.
  - Use it under the MIT License.
